ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two edge-triggered D flip-flops driven by the same 12 kHz clock line. The output Q1 of the first flip-flop is connected to the D2 input of the second flip-flop. The D1 input of the first flip-flop is driven by a two-input gate whose feedback connections correspond to not Q1 and not Q2. Thus the circuit connections give D1 = (not Q1)(not Q2) and D2 = Q1. Reasoning: For D flip-flops, the next state equals the D input, so Q1+ = (not Q1)(not Q2) and Q2+ = Q1. Starting from state Q1Q2 = 00: next is 10; from 10: next is 01; from 01: next is 00. Therefore the repeating sequence is 00, 10, 01, with a period of 3 clock cycles. Hence Q2 repeats every 3 input clock periods, so its frequency is 12 kHz / 3 = 4 kHz. Final answer: 4 kHz.
